about: The house lexicon: words rendered the same way in every book that has them. Copy to house_lexicon.json (gitignored) and edit; this example is what a clone without one reads. It replaces forced_glossary_terms.json, which is still read while no house_lexicon.json exists. Each entry: english (required), spanish (null = always raise the word as a glossary candidate with no house rendering yet; set = pre-fill the book glossary whenever the word occurs in the source, overridable at the glossary gate), alternatives, scope (every_book, the default, or group:<id> from book_groups.json), why, origin, type_guess (character|place|concept|technical|other). Matching is case-insensitive with simple plural, possessive and past-tense variants, the same as the glossary filter. An entry reaches the translator only through the book glossary, so only in the chunks that contain the word.
